summary: Independently reviewed amdpilot-org/sglang PR 2788 at exact commit 6919f2e20ec866a7df61897448ff7f7c86d60904. The recorded base lacks the requested panel. The candidate adds a separate token-weighted prefix-cache panel using the requested prefill cache and compute counters while leaving the existing Cache Hit Rate panel byte-for-byte unchanged. Candidate tests and independent adversarial checks passed. This is a full fix of the dashboard-only original issue, not merely test hardening. The documented zero-prefill 0/0 no-data behavior is not a counterexample to the requested contract.

gpu_execution_evidence: Not applicable: the original contract and candidate affect only static Grafana dashboard JSON and CPU-side tests. No model, kernel, numerical GPU, HTTP serving, or distributed path is changed. GPU execution would not validate PromQL/dashboard semantics.
remaining_limitations: No live Grafana/Prometheus stack was provisioned, so visual rendering and live time-series evaluation were not exercised; JSON structure, source counter definitions, exact query semantics, and arithmetic were checked independently.
An interval with no prefill tokens has a zero denominator and therefore yields Prometheus no-data/NaN rather than a fabricated percentage; the candidate explicitly records this behavior.

The raw prometheus_client exposition preserves colon-form metric names, while the repository dashboard consistently uses underscore-form queries. The candidate follows the established dashboard convention and the open related upstream PR, but this review did not stand up the full scrape pipeline to observe its negotiated/relabelled series names.

Architecture-specific GPU/model, distributed, and serving paths were not run because they are outside this dashboard-only issue. repository-environment.json records native and wheel as null; the candidate changes no C++/native source, so no native rebuild exists or is required.
